title: S1: language seam and command contract for Python (ADR 0008)
description: ADR 0008 / DEC-303 (a2) slice S1: a LanguageIndexer seam over the TypeScript indexer with no behaviour change for TypeScript-only repositories, language detection, --language, one language per run, coverage-line entry for languages not indexed, additive contract fields recorded in ADR 0002. No Python indexer and no new dependency.

acceptanceCriteria.text: TypeScript-only output is byte-identical to dev, proven by a test that fails if it changes
--language and detection select one language per run; a language not indexed is named with its file count in the coverage line; an unregistered language is a clear usage error, never a silent empty
Additive fields are declared in help --json and recorded in ADR 0002
bun run check and lore check are green
